breakpoint.$description: Viewport range for this platform (Material 3 window size classes): mobile 0–599, tablet 600–1199, web 1200 and wider.

min.$description: Smallest viewport width of this platform.

max.$description: Largest viewport width of this platform (web has no maximum).

size.$description: Font sizes (shared by EN and AR).

lg.$description: Rare, very large hero title. Use for onboarding splash or major report covers on web; high-emphasis screens on tablet; onboarding or hero-style screens on mobile. Not for normal pages.

md.$description: Large feature title used when Display.lg is too dominant. Web: featured report titles. Tablet: large feature screens. Mobile: important entry screens.

lg.$description: Default page title across web, tablet, and mobile. Use at the top of any standard page.

md.$description: Heading for a major section within a page, on web, tablet, and mobile.

sm.$description: Subsection heading nested under a section heading, on web, tablet, and mobile.

lg.$description: Title for a card, panel, or surface — not a full page. Used on web, tablet, and mobile.

md.$description: Compact title inside a dense surface (e.g. sidebar widget on web, compact list/card on tablet and mobile).

lg.$description: Long-form readable text — empty-state copy, important descriptions on web; comfortable long-reading content on tablet (extra line-height); prominent readable text on mobile.

md.$description: Default paragraph or dashboard text size on web, tablet, and mobile.

sm.$description: Secondary, less prominent body copy on web, tablet, and mobile.

lg.$description: Prominent form label or strong UI label, used on web, tablet, and mobile.

md.$description: Standard compact UI label, used on web, tablet, and mobile.

sm.$description: Smallest label size — dense metadata in tight spaces, on web, tablet, and mobile.

md.$description: Helper text, hints, or low-emphasis notes below an input or section. Used on web, tablet, and mobile — the smallest readable text on tablet/mobile (do not go below this on those platforms).

sm.$description: Web only. Rare, extremely dense metadata where 12px is still too large. Use sparingly. Not used on tablet or mobile — those platforms have no value smaller than Caption.md.

lg.$description: Button and link text. Same value as title-lg (aliased so they never drift); kept as its own role so components say what the text is for.

md.$description: Button and link text. Same value as label-lg (aliased so they never drift); kept as its own role so components say what the text is for.

sm.$description: Button and link text. Same value as label-md (aliased so they never drift); kept as its own role so components say what the text is for.

lg.$description: Important metric or dashboard value that needs visual weight, on web, tablet, and mobile.

md.$description: Everyday numeric values — dates, times, counts — on web, tablet, and mobile.

sm.$description: Small, secondary numeric values, e.g. count badges, on web, tablet, and mobile.

md.$description: Serial numbers, device IDs, API keys, codes in tables and detail panels (monospace, JetBrains Mono). Latin characters only.

sm.$description: Small monospace: inline IDs in captions, table cells in dense lists.

body.$description: 400 (Regular). Body text; inline emphasis inside body uses 600.

action.$description: 500 (Medium) — aliases label. Text inside actions (buttons, links).

data.$description: 500 (Medium). Numbers and values in data displays.

display.$description: Slight negative tracking for large Latin text.

default.$description: 0 for all English text except display (letter-spacing-display, −0.16).
Arabic is a connected script: letter-spacing must always be 0.

columns.$description: Number of grid columns: web 12, tablet 8, mobile 4. Content spans whole columns.

gutter.$description: Space between grid columns: web 24, tablet 24, mobile 16. Equals spacing-layout-group, so cards and blocks follow the column rhythm.

full.$description: Page margin when no sidebar is shown: web 40, tablet 24, mobile 16.

sidebar.$description: Page margin between a persistent sidebar or rail and the content: web 24, tablet 24, mobile 16.

margin.$description: Outer page margin: space between the viewport edge (or a sidebar) and the first column.

grid.$description: Fluid column grid for this platform. Columns stretch; gutter and margins are fixed. In Figma apply the grid style "Grid/Full width" or "Grid/With sidebar" and set the frame mode of 6. Grid & Layout.

layout.$description: Layout spacing between components. Changes per platform: set the frame's 6. Grid & Layout mode (Figma) or data-platform / BwLayout (code).

section.$description: Layout · Vertical gap between page sections that each have their own heading. Not for: space inside a card or form.

group.$description: Layout · Gap between sibling blocks inside a section — cards in a row or grid, form groups, dashboard widgets. Equals grid-gutter so blocks follow the column rhythm. Not for: fields inside one form group (use layout/stack).

stack.$description: Layout · Gap between consecutive items in a vertical flow inside a container — section heading to content, field to field, paragraph to paragraph, content to the actions row. Not for: icon-to-text or other gaps inside one component.

container.$description: Layout · Padding from the edge of a surface container to its content — card, dialog, side panel, bottom sheet. Not for: controls, list rows or tooltips (use control/* or the component scale).

app-bar.$description: App bar (App header) height: web 72, tablet and mobile 64.

system-status.$description: Biowave System Status Bar height (the in-app status strip, not the OS status bar): 40 on every platform.

sidebar-start.$description: Start-side navigation width (left in LTR, right in RTL): web 248 persistent sidebar; tablet 80 navigation rail (icons + short labels); mobile 0 — navigation opens as a modal drawer.

sidebar-end.$description: End-side panel width (details, filters): web 248 persistent; tablet and mobile 0 — the panel opens as a sheet over the content.

layout.$description: Fixed heights and widths of the app frame regions.

min.$description: Minimum interactive target (hit area, not visual size): web 24 (WCAG 2.5.8), tablet and mobile 48 (Material 48dp, above Apple 44pt).
